readiness_semantics: READY means registered and dispatchable, not currently running

captains.name: Manager
captains.mission: Own global orchestration, select the active authorized site, delegate to captains/teams, enforce policy, resolve priorities and report truthfully.

captains.name: Researcher
captains.mission: Turn authorized-source research into structured evidence and actionable tasks; manage future research agents.

captains.name: Image Agent
captains.mission: Manage authorized media discovery, transformation and validation; never bypass access controls or copyright restrictions.

captains.name: Publisher
captains.mission: Manage build, content integration, release and deployment agents for the active authorized site.

captains.name: SEO Agent
captains.mission: Manage technical SEO, metadata, internal linking, sitemap, indexing readiness and search diagnostics.

captains.name: QA Agent
captains.mission: Own verification gates, regression checks and release acceptance; never mark completion without evidence.

captains.name: Bug Hunter
captains.mission: Lead failure investigation, isolate root causes and produce reproducible repair plans.

captains.name: Bug Solver
captains.mission: Lead safe repairs, regression checks and rollback-ready changes; return evidence to QA.

captains.name: Idea Builder
captains.mission: Develop and score future site/product ideas without interrupting the active-site execution lock.

child_agents.name: Planner
child_agents.mission: Break the requested outcome into ordered tasks.
child_agents.expected_evidence: A task graph with owners, dependencies, and measurable acceptance criteria.

child_agents.name: Scheduler
child_agents.mission: Order eligible tasks under the single-active-site lock.
child_agents.expected_evidence: A valid execution order with no concurrent site claims.

child_agents.name: Policy Checker
child_agents.mission: Check site authorization and task constraints before work.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Explicit pass/block decision with the policy checks recorded.

child_agents.name: State Keeper
child_agents.mission: Validate persisted runtime state and transition consistency.
child_agents.expected_evidence: State snapshot with no conflicting active-site or invalid transition.

child_agents.name: Reporter
child_agents.mission: Summarize verified progress and blockers for the manager.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Report cites runtime events or artifacts and distinguishes unknowns.

child_agents.name: Plan Auditor
child_agents.mission: Independently inspect the planner's task graph, dependencies, owners, and acceptance criteria.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Audit findings mapped to missing or conflicting requirements.

child_agents.name: Dependency Auditor
child_agents.mission: Independently check scheduler ordering and dependency readiness.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Dependency audit proving no task is dispatched early.

child_agents.name: Authorization Auditor
child_agents.mission: Independently verify policy-checker decisions against site/task permissions.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Recorded allow/block decision and supporting policy evidence.

child_agents.name: State Auditor
child_agents.mission: Cross-check persisted state for invalid transitions, duplicate claims, and conflicting locks.
child_agents.expected_evidence: State consistency report with conflicts identified.

child_agents.name: Evidence Auditor
child_agents.mission: Independently check progress reports against run logs and artifacts.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Report-to-evidence reconciliation and unsupported-claim list.

child_agents.name: Source Discovery
child_agents.mission: Identify sources explicitly authorized for the active site.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Source list with URLs, access scope, and relevance notes.

child_agents.name: Fact Checker
child_agents.mission: Cross-check claims against authorized evidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Claim/evidence pairs and unresolved conflicts.

child_agents.name: Analyst
child_agents.mission: Convert evidence into actionable findings.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Prioritized findings with rationale and source references.

child_agents.name: Trend Researcher
child_agents.mission: Assess supported changes or patterns over time.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Time-bounded observations with dates and evidence.

child_agents.name: Research Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review research quality and traceability.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Pass/fail checklist and missing-evidence list.

child_agents.name: Source Cross Checker
child_agents.mission: Independently check source relevance, accessibility, and authorization.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Source-by-source verification notes.

child_agents.name: Claim Verifier
child_agents.mission: Verify key claims independently against the collected evidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Claim/evidence matrix with conflicts and unknowns.

child_agents.name: Recommendation Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Challenge analysis priorities and test whether recommendations follow from evidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Reviewed priority list and rationale.

child_agents.name: Trend Verifier
child_agents.mission: Check time windows, dates, and alternative explanations for trend claims.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Verified trend timeline and uncertainty notes.

child_agents.name: Citation Auditor
child_agents.mission: Audit source links and traceability for the research brief.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Citation completeness report and unsupported-claim list.

child_agents.name: Source Validator
child_agents.mission: Validate the configured source and allowed usage.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Source authorization result and source provenance.

child_agents.name: Asset Preparer
child_agents.mission: Prepare permitted assets for site use.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Asset paths, format checks, and transformation notes.

child_agents.name: Metadata Writer
child_agents.mission: Write descriptive metadata and alt text.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Metadata tied to the actual asset and page context.

child_agents.name: Rights Checker
child_agents.mission: Check documented rights and usage constraints.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Rights decision with evidence; block if unclear.

child_agents.name: Media Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review assets for quality and policy compliance.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Review result with asset references and required fixes.

child_agents.name: Provenance Auditor
child_agents.mission: Independently verify asset origin and permitted use.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Asset provenance checklist and unresolved source issues.

child_agents.name: Asset Quality Checker
child_agents.mission: Inspect prepared assets for dimensions, format, corruption, and quality.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Per-asset technical QA results.

child_agents.name: Metadata Auditor
child_agents.mission: Check metadata and alt text against the actual asset and page context.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Metadata accuracy and accessibility findings.

child_agents.name: License Verifier
child_agents.mission: Independently verify license evidence and usage constraints.
child_agents.expected_evidence: License decision with source evidence; block unclear rights.

child_agents.name: Accessibility Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Check contrast, legibility, descriptive text, and accessible presentation.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Accessibility review and concrete corrections.

child_agents.name: Content Builder
child_agents.mission: Prepare content changes within the approved scope.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Changed-file list and content acceptance checks.

child_agents.name: Frontend Worker
child_agents.mission: Implement approved frontend changes.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Changed-file list and build evidence.

child_agents.name: Release Worker
child_agents.mission: Prepare a release candidate from approved changes.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Release summary, commit reference, and rollback point.

child_agents.name: Deployment Checker
child_agents.mission: Verify deployment workflow and target status.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Workflow run URL/status or explicit not-verified result.

child_agents.name: Rollback Worker
child_agents.mission: Prepare or execute an authorized rollback plan.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Target commit and rollback verification; no destructive action without authorization.

child_agents.name: Content Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Independently review changed content against the approved brief.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Content acceptance checklist and discrepancies.

child_agents.name: Frontend Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review frontend diff for scope, responsiveness, and maintainability.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Diff review with issues and approval decision.

child_agents.name: Release Auditor
child_agents.mission: Check release contents, commit reference, and required gates.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Release manifest and gate-completeness result.

child_agents.name: Deployment Smoke Tester
child_agents.mission: Independently test published routes and essential page behavior.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Smoke-test URLs, results, and captured evidence.

child_agents.name: Recovery Verifier
child_agents.mission: Check rollback instructions and verify the intended recovery reference.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Recovery checklist and known-good commit evidence.

child_agents.name: Keyword Researcher
child_agents.mission: Research relevant search intent from authorized sources.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Keyword groups with intent and evidence/source notes.

child_agents.name: Metadata Worker
child_agents.mission: Validate titles, descriptions, canonical, and indexing directives.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Per-URL metadata checklist and detected issues.

child_agents.name: Internal Link Worker
child_agents.mission: Check internal links and navigation paths.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Broken-link report and proposed link changes.

child_agents.name: Sitemap Worker
child_agents.mission: Validate sitemap coverage and URL consistency.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Sitemap parse result and URL coverage findings.

child_agents.name: Indexing Diagnostics
child_agents.mission: Assess crawl/indexing signals without claiming guaranteed indexing.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Evidence-backed diagnosis and next checks.

child_agents.name: Intent Validator
child_agents.mission: Independently validate keyword grouping against search intent evidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Intent review with mismatches and source notes.

child_agents.name: Metadata Auditor
child_agents.mission: Recheck titles, descriptions, canonicals, and robots directives independently.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Per-URL metadata verification report.

child_agents.name: Link Verifier
child_agents.mission: Recheck internal links and proposed navigation changes.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Verified link results and redirect/error notes.

child_agents.name: Sitemap Cross Checker
child_agents.mission: Compare sitemap URLs with canonical and site route inventories.
child_agents.expected_evidence: URL coverage reconciliation and conflicts.

child_agents.name: Crawl Evidence Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Independently interpret available crawl/indexing signals and uncertainty.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Evidence review distinguishing observed facts from hypotheses.

child_agents.name: Functional Tester
child_agents.mission: Test core user-facing flows against acceptance criteria.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Reproducible test cases and pass/fail results.

child_agents.name: Ui Tester
child_agents.mission: Check layout, interaction, and responsive behavior.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Viewport-specific findings with reproduction steps.

child_agents.name: Seo Tester
child_agents.mission: Check technical SEO requirements for changed pages.
child_agents.expected_evidence: URL-level checks with results.

child_agents.name: Performance Tester
child_agents.mission: Measure available build/runtime performance signals.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Measured metrics, test conditions, and thresholds.

child_agents.name: Release Gatekeeper
child_agents.mission: Aggregate evidence and decide whether release criteria pass.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Release decision with blockers; never infer success from missing evidence.

child_agents.name: Journey Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Independently verify functional test coverage against user journeys.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Coverage gaps and independently reproduced results.

child_agents.name: Visual Regression Checker
child_agents.mission: Check visual results at agreed viewports against baseline evidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Viewport comparison and regression findings.

child_agents.name: Seo Independent Checker
child_agents.mission: Independently rerun technical SEO checks on changed URLs.
child_agents.expected_evidence: URL-level pass/fail evidence.

child_agents.name: Benchmark Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review performance measurements, environment, and thresholds.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Metric validity and repeatability review.

child_agents.name: Release Evidence Auditor
child_agents.mission: Audit all release gates and block missing or stale evidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Gate-by-gate evidence matrix and release recommendation.

child_agents.name: Log Analyzer
child_agents.mission: Inspect available logs for actionable failure signals.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Relevant log excerpts, timestamps, and suspected failure stage.

child_agents.name: Reproduction Agent
child_agents.mission: Create a minimal reproducible case for a reported issue.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Steps, expected/actual behavior, and reproduction result.

child_agents.name: Root Cause Analyst
child_agents.mission: Separate root cause from symptoms using evidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Ranked causes with supporting and contradicting evidence.

child_agents.name: Regression Planner
child_agents.mission: Define checks that prevent the issue returning.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Regression test list mapped to the defect.

child_agents.name: Diagnostic Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review diagnosis completeness and confidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Reviewed cause, confidence, and remaining unknowns.

child_agents.name: Log Cross Checker
child_agents.mission: Cross-check log findings across available runs and timestamps.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Correlated log timeline and discrepancies.

child_agents.name: Reproduction Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Independently repeat reproduction steps where possible.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Reproduction result or explicit inability to reproduce.

child_agents.name: Hypothesis Challenger
child_agents.mission: Challenge the proposed root cause with alternative explanations.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Ranked hypotheses and disconfirming evidence.

child_agents.name: Regression Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review regression coverage against the diagnosed failure mode.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Coverage gaps and proposed regression cases.

child_agents.name: Diagnosis Auditor
child_agents.mission: Audit incident report completeness and confidence calibration.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Diagnosis acceptance checklist and unresolved unknowns.

child_agents.name: Patch Agent
child_agents.mission: Propose the smallest safe fix within authorized files.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Patch diff and rationale; no unapproved scope expansion.

child_agents.name: Test Agent
child_agents.mission: Run relevant checks against the proposed fix.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Exact commands/checks and results, including failures.

child_agents.name: Security Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review the change for access-control and secret-handling risks.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Security findings and explicit pass/block result.

child_agents.name: Rollback Planner
child_agents.mission: Define recovery steps before risky release changes.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Known-good reference and tested or clearly untested rollback steps.

child_agents.name: Repair Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review fix quality and required regression evidence.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Acceptance decision linked to patch and test evidence.

child_agents.name: Patch Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Independently inspect the patch diff for scope and correctness.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Review comments and explicit approve/request-changes result.

child_agents.name: Test Independence Checker
child_agents.mission: Check that tests genuinely exercise the fix rather than repeat implementation assumptions.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Test-quality review and missing cases.

child_agents.name: Threat Model Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Independently review permission boundaries, secrets, and abuse paths.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Threat findings and explicit pass/block decision.

child_agents.name: Rollback Verifier
child_agents.mission: Check recovery steps and whether the referenced recovery point exists.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Rollback-readiness checklist and verification evidence.

child_agents.name: Acceptance Auditor
child_agents.mission: Compare repair output and test evidence against the original acceptance criteria.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Acceptance matrix with pass/fail and evidence links.

child_agents.name: Idea Researcher
child_agents.mission: Collect evidence for a proposed product or site idea.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Evidence-backed problem statement and source notes.

child_agents.name: Opportunity Analyst
child_agents.mission: Score demand, feasibility, and risks transparently.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Scoring rubric, assumptions, and uncertainty notes.

child_agents.name: Prototype Planner
child_agents.mission: Define a small testable prototype.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.

child_agents.name: Experiment Agent
child_agents.mission: Track an approved experiment and its measurements.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Experiment record with baseline, observation window, and results.

child_agents.name: Idea Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Review whether evidence supports continuing the idea.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Continue/pivot/stop recommendation with rationale.

child_agents.name: Idea Fact Checker
child_agents.mission: Independently verify factual assumptions and source claims in a proposal.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Fact-check matrix and uncertainty notes.

child_agents.name: Scoring Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Challenge opportunity scores, weights, and hidden assumptions.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Recomputed score and sensitivity notes.

child_agents.name: Scope Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Check prototype scope for feasibility, dependencies, and measurable criteria.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Reviewed scope and acceptance criteria.

child_agents.name: Measurement Auditor
child_agents.mission: Verify experiment baseline, metrics, observation window, and calculations.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Measurement audit with missing-data notes.

child_agents.name: Experiment Reviewer
child_agents.mission: Independently assess experiment results and the continue/pivot/stop recommendation.
child_agents.expected_evidence: Evidence-based review and recommendation.
